incidents.name: HackDao token pair-balance skim
incidents.notes: The HackDao token's _transfer() burns/redistributes tokens out of the liquidity pair's own balance without calling sync(), so the attacker repeatedly skim()ed the resulting surplus and swapped it for the pair's WBNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: HackDao 0x94e06c77b02Ade8341489Ab9A23451F68c13eC1C created 2022-02-11T05:05:15Z by 0xbc1424bfa11934ab06a67dcad17b5cd71a01b4a3, unrelated to attack sender 0xcfc591db031b760961fe8943a183741ed7cd1f82; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 175.21 WBNB left the HackDao/WBNB pair to the attack contract 0x24cb6980995aeb7d5a9204e04b17dcd1e99a4694. Loss converted: 175.2083 WBNB x $325.71 at incidentTimestamp 1653374630 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $57,067.
